name: IsRatCondKernelCDFAux.tendsto_atBot_zero

name: lintegral_toKernel_mem
statement: IsCondKernelCDF f κ ν) (a : α) {s : Set (β × ℝ)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) : ∫⁻ b, hf.toKernel f (a, b) (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s) ∂(ν a) = κ a s
